summary: 262 rows desk-checked; ~95 web calls. 77 findings: 9 defunct/sunset (Mariner, Ottogrid, AgentGPT, Lightfern, Tome, Flowrite, Phind, Drift x2, Wepik), 6 renamed (Operator->ChatGPT agent, Moltbot->OpenClaw, Phrasee->Jacquard, DALL-E 3->ChatGPT Images, Gemini Advanced->Google AI Pro, CodeWhisperer->Amazon Q Developer), 7 duplicates (Perplexity, Scalenut, Lindy, Gumloop, Gong, Drift, Canva), wrong domains (Flux->bfl.ai, Manus->manus.im, Moltbot, Windsurf), and many stale prices among surfaced rows (Skyvern, Gumloop, Sintra, Relevance, Fyxer, Shortwave, Spark, Instantly, Jasper, Copilot Outlook, Notion AI, Freshdesk, Manus 'invite'). Logic: Email/Inbox and Research are mis-mapped for p6 and p9; Customer Support is wrong for reminder/no-show problems (p46, p72); p48 clinical charting should not map to generic notetakers.

logic.why: Email / Inbox tools are personal inbox productivity apps (Superhuman, SaneBox, Boomerang), not customer-nurture email marketing; staying in touch with past customers is Marketing (ActiveCampaign, HubSpot).

Research category is academic/market-research search (Elicit, Semantic Scholar, AlphaSense) and does not capture tacit knowledge; knowledge-base/docs tools like Notion AI (Writing & Content) and meeting capture fit. Education & Learning (SOP/training) also reasonable.
Customer Support category is helpdesk/ticketing (Zendesk, Intercom, Gong); appointment reminders are handled by booking software or automation (Zapier/Make SMS reminders).
Same as p46: no-shows/cancellations are a booking/reminder automation problem, not helpdesk.
General notetakers (Otter, Fireflies, Read AI) are not clinical scribes and raise patient-privacy issues (see p49); rely on clinic/EMR group, or add a dedicated health-compliant AI scribe category.
Consistency with p17 (quotes); estimating/quoting is a sales workflow.
Proposal builders (Storydoc, Gamma, Pitch) sit in Presentation.
